# CG-API-007: Callback definitions changed

Callbacks on an operation differ; callbacks are not analyzed in v1.

**Why it matters:** Unknown impact is reported as undetermined rather than guessed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `schema.unsupportedChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Callbacks of {operation} changed and were not analyzed.
>
> ContractGuard v1 does not compare callback contents, so the impact is unknown.
>
> **Fix:** Review the callback changes manually.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: callbacks added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {post: {callbacks: {cb: {'{$request.body#/u}': {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}}}, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, low. Callbacks of POST /a changed and were not analyzed.

### Does not fire: callbacks identical

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /a: {post: {callbacks: {cb: {'{$request.body#/u}': {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}}}, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Full callback analysis is planned after 1.0.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-007
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-007: { severity: low }
```
